title: Runtime Billing Reconciliation & Explainability Playbook
author: Aisha Kapoor
body:
Summary
-------
This playbook describes Redwood's approach for real-time billing reconciliation and explainability for multi-tenant inference consumption. It defines the data model, reconciliation checks, human-in-the-loop investigation steps, alert thresholds, and rollout guidance for the Runtime Billing Reconciliation service (product name: Billing Reconcile). The goal is to ensure customers and internal teams can trustedly map observed invoices to runtime telemetry with transparent, machine-readable explanations.

Goals
-----
- Reduce billing disputes by 90% for tenants with >$5k monthly spend within the first six months after launch.
- Provide per-invoice, per-route explainability with a verifiable reconciliation score and traceable evidence bundle.
- Detect and auto-resolve common mismatches (e.g., clock skew, duplicate tokens) for >80% of detected anomalies.

Scope
-----
Included:
- Hosted and Dedicated runtime consumption records (hosted-inference, dedicated-pool).
- Per-tenant invoicing at daily and monthly aggregation levels.
- Explainability outputs: token breakdown, batch attribution, fallback events, and quantization adjustments.

Excluded:
- External third-party reseller invoicing workflows (handled by Finance integrations team).
- Deep forensic audits requiring HSM logs or customer-side telemetry (handled as escalation).

Key Concepts and Terminology
----------------------------
- invoice_event: The composed document used for billing (line items, start/end times, reconciliation score).
- evidence_bundle: Time-limited signed data artifacts (telemetry slices, route traces, kernel-attribution) attached to invoice_event.
- reconciliation_score: A 0-100 integer capturing confidence that invoice line items match runtime telemetry (100 = perfect).
- soft_mismatch: A recon result where automated heuristics found minor inconsistencies and auto-adjusted billing metadata.

High-level Architecture
-----------------------
Components:
- telemetry-bridge: Aggregates per-request runtime signals (tokens, latency, model variant, kernel path) and pushes to the recon data lake.
- recon-orchestrator: Orchestrates daily reconciliation jobs, computes reconciliation_score, and emits invoice_event.
- billing-reconcile-api: Serves explainability queries and evidence bundles for customer-facing UI and internal investigations.
- reconciler-worker: Performs deterministic event matching, duplication checks, and anomaly classification.
- ledger-store (immutable): Stores signed invoice_event records and evidence bundle references for 365 days (default).

Data Model (table)
------------------
Columns shown for core invoice_event record:
| field | type (semantic) | description | example |
| invoice_id | string | Unique invoice identifier | inv_2027_000123 |
| tenant_id | string | Customer tenant id | ten_ABC123 |
| period_start | ISO8601 | Aggregation window start | 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z |
| period_end | ISO8601 | Aggregation window end | 2027-01-31T23:59:59Z |
| total_tokens | integer | Sum of billable tokens attributed | 12,345,678 |
| charge_cents | integer | Rounded charge in cents | 123456 |
| reconciliation_score | integer | 0-100 confidence score | 93 |
| evidence_refs | list[string] | References to evidence_bundle IDs | [ev_20270115_42] |

Reconciliation Checks (priority order)
-------------------------------------
1) Ingest completeness: Verify telemetry-bridge delivered >99.5% of expected request envelopes for the window.
2) Deduplication: Collapse duplicate request_ids across ingestion retries.
3) Model-variant mapping: Ensure runtime model mapping to pricing SKU exists; if absent, mark as soft_mismatch and apply fallback SKU.
4) Batch redistribution: Attribute batched tokens according to measured batch boundaries; flag anomalies if >1% of tokens are unattributed.
5) Time-window drift: Detect clock skew >5s between runtime and telemetry collectors; apply time-correction rules or mark for manual review.
6) Fallback accounting: Include fallback events (variant downgrades, regional fallback) as annotated line items.

Automated Resolution Heuristics
------------------------------
- If reconciliation_score >= 95: auto-commit invoice_event and publish invoice to billing pipeline.
- If 80 <= reconciliation_score < 95 and mismatches are only of type model-variant mapping or batch redistribution, attempt automated repair: apply conservative token rounding heuristics and re-run checks.
- If reconciliation_score < 80: mark invoice_event for manual review by Billing Ops and create investigation ticket in JIRA (project: BILL-RECON).

Evidence Bundle Contents
------------------------
Each evidence_bundle must contain:
- telemetry slice (ndjson): subset of request envelopes (request_id, tenant_id, timestamp, tokens_in, model_variant, route_id) signed by telemetry-bridge.
- kernel attribution log (text): list of kernel variants used and quantization profile ids for the window.
- batching map (json): mapping of batch_id -> [request_ids].
- audit manifest (yaml): computed hashes and recon-orchestrator run id.

Explainability API (examples)
----------------------------
- GET /reconcile/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}?evidence=true -> returns invoice_event + ephemeral presigned links to evidence_bundle files.
- POST /reconcile/v1/adjustments/{invoice_id} (restricted) -> request a manual override with justification.

Alerting and SLOs
------------------
Primary SLOs:
- Reconciliation latency: 99th percentile end-to-end recon job completion within 6 hours for daily windows.
- Evidence availability: evidence bundle retrieval within 3s for 95% of API calls.
- Auto-resolution rate: 80% of eligible soft_mismatch cases auto-resolved within 1 hour.
Alert thresholds and actions:
- If ingestion completeness < 99.5% -> fire P0 to eng-platform on-call; create temporary hold on invoice issuance for affected tenants.
- If reconciliation_job > 12 hours -> notify Billing Ops and escalate to SRE.
- If evidence retrieval latency > 5s for >1 hour -> open incident with telemetry-bridge team.

Investigatio n Playbook (step-by-step)
-------------------------------------
1) Triage: Billing Ops checks reconciliation_score and mismatch type in billing-reconcile-ui.
2) Automated remediation: When applicable, trigger the auto-repair job (recon-orchestrator/repair) and capture pre/post diffs.
3) Evidence review: Download evidence_bundle and validate telemetry signatures against telemetry-bridge public key (key id: tb-2026-01).
4) Root-cause hypotheses (common): clock skew, duplicated retries, missing model->sku mapping, batch attribution loss, regional fallback.
5) If unresolved: open JIRA BILL-RECON ticket, assign to Eng-Serving-Runtime and include evidence refs and suggested rollback/credit.
6) Customer communication: Use templated responses; include reconciliation_score, top 3 contributing evidence items, and an expected resolution timeline.

Rollout Plan and Phases
-----------------------
Phase 0 (pilot, 30 days)
- Target: 5 strategic tenants (mix of hosted & dedicated), shadow invoices emitted but not billed.
- Metrics: false positive dispute rate, evidence retrieval times.
- Owners: Product (Aisha), Billing Ops (Marco), Eng-Serving-Runtime (Evan).

Phase 1 (initial launch, 8 weeks)
- Expand to tenants with monthly spend < $10k, enable auto-commit when reconciliation_score >= 97.
- Add pre-commit notifications to customers via console and daily digest.

Phase 2 (enterprise enablement, 3 months)
- Enable per-route explainability exports and SLA-backed retrieval windows for enterprise tiers.
- Integrate credit-escrow automation for disputed invoices.

Phase 3 (global, 6 months)
- Support region-specific evidence retention policies, local ledger-store replication, and regulatory export controls.

Security, Privacy, and Compliance Considerations
------------------------------------------------
- Evidence bundles contain potentially sensitive runtime request metadata. Access must be audited and role-based (RBAC) via the Console.
- Data retention policy defaults to 365 days; Finance/legal can request extended retention under a contract amendment.
- All evidence bundles are signed and HMAC-protected. Keys rotate quarterly.

Operational Runbooks and Playbooks
----------------------------------
- Runbook: Daily recon job failing -> steps to restart recon-orchestrator, validate data lake partitioning, and reindex evidence refs.
- Playbook: Invoice dispute escalation -> how to apply one-off credits, rollback issued invoice_event, and re-run reconciliation.

Instrumentation and Telemetry
-----------------------------
Minimum telemetry required per request:
- request_id, tenant_id, timestamp, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_variant, variant_sku_id, batch_id, route_id, gpu_kernel_id, quant_profile_id
Dashboards to create:
- Daily reconciliation coverage (% requests matched)
- Reconciliation score distribution histogram
- Evidence retrieval P95/P99

Ownership and Contacts
----------------------
- Product owner: Aisha Kapoor (product)
- Billing Ops (owner runbook): Marco Chen (finance-legal)
- Runtime instrumentation: Evan Brooks (eng-serving-runtime)
- SRE escalation: Priya Nambiar (eng-sre)

Appendices
---------
A. Example JQL for disputed invoices:
project = BILL-RECON AND status = "Open" AND reconciliation_score < 80 ORDER BY created DESC

B. Example tenant notification template (trimmed):
"We detected a reconciliation mismatch in your invoice for the period {period_start} - {period_end}. Reconciliation score: {score}. Evidence bundle available at: {link}. Our team will respond within 48 hours."

C. Open questions and future work:
- Define contract between reconcile-orchestrator and Optimize Conductor to allow cost adjustments based on post-facto quantization changes.
- Support granular legal redaction for evidence bundles on per-tenant policy.

Document history
----------------
- 2026-11-20: Draft created by Aisha Kapoor.
- 2026-12-14: Added evidence bundle schema and automated resolution heuristics (reviewer: Rina Patel).
- 2027-01-15: Updated rollout phases, added SLO targets, and set confidentiality to restricted (reviewers: Marco Chen, Evan Brooks).
